problem_type: Merge admission turns missing inspection evidence into an empty change or a legacy exemption
symptom: PR #2 exceeds the hosted diff limit; missing policy PR #961 then makes an incompletely inspected PR print clean and exit zero.
direct_cause: view.files remains available, but the hosted diff error is swallowed into an empty diff string, losing AbortController/AbortSignal classification. Missing effectiveAt then defaults isGrandfathered to true. File statuses are also guessed from addition counts instead of actual Git status.
class_root: Admission must bind a complete immutable change set to the requested PR and require positive evidence before applying a historical exemption.
affected_population: Fork repositories without the policy anchor
Paths containing whitespace, newlines or non-ASCII characters
internal_only_reason: The defect is internal error-to-success conversion. Reuse the repository's existing Git path decoder and actual local Git executable; regression uses real commit objects and isolated gh transport fixtures, without asserting hosted network behavior.
invariants: Resolve complete PR metadata from the requested target repository and PR number, with explicit base/head commit SHAs and changed_files
Read paths and added lines from the same SHA-bound three-point Git diff, never the current checkout or an unbound hosted diff
Validate file count before classification; missing objects, missing ancestry and incomplete data fail closed without automatic fetch
Historical exemption requires two valid timestamps and a strictly earlier createdAt; unknown policy time enforces current rules
Keep four-class, design-card and independent-acceptance rules unchanged; the existing src/**/*.tsx path wildcard must include legal newline filenames

door_reduction.why_not: Before map covers classifyChange/isGrandfathered; after map adds the new explicit readPullRequestChanges boundary, generated with door-map --read=isGrandfathered,classifyChange,readPullRequestChanges --roots=scripts --include-tests. Each boundary has the required main consumer and independent regression consumer. This adds one tested acquisition boundary, not an alternate admission path.

generality_proof: The common CLI/imported main path obtains one complete change set before classification. Real Git fixtures cover large diffs, divergent bases and unusual paths; an actual CLI subprocess retains nonempty view.files and proves that lost diff text and policy lookup errors no longer compose into clean exit zero. The existing added-src-TSX wildcard covers newline filenames without changing categories or directory/extension rules. Valid legacy and strict compliant PRs remain accepted.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind target repository/PR metadata and fail before classification when complete evidence is unavailable
Resolve exact immutable Git change set and verify changed-file completeness
Require positive chronological evidence for historical exemption

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual standalone subprocess uses real local Git and isolated failing hosted-diff/policy transport
The same main body is exercised with malformed metadata, missing objects and valid legacy evidence
Existing canonical NUL decoder is reused unchanged for newline and renamed paths

recurrence.reason: Any future large diff, unavailable API or fork missing the anchor can reach the same false-success conversions.
same_class_scan: Read the entire merge-preflight acquisition and report tail
Read gitPaths NUL and rename parsing
Read existing policy and classification tests
Generated bounded scripts door map, avoiding unrelated generic main symbols

prevention.invariant: Only a complete PR-bound change set may enter classification; only proven legacy dates may soften failures
prevention.failure_mode: Incomplete change evidence returns nonzero; unknown policy time prints strict-mode diagnostic and cannot soften required checks
prevention.strategy: Replace lossy hosted-diff acquisition with checked local Git three-point diff and positive timestamp validation

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove diff-error-to-empty and unknown-time-to-legacy behavior; retain date-proven legacy compatibility and all original admission rules.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency or API replacement. Use installed Git and the existing canonical path helper; no fetch or new package.

migration: No project data migration. Callers need the PR's exact base/head Git objects locally; missing objects fail explicitly rather than fetching or scanning another revision.
residual_risks: Real hosted PR #2 re-execution is reserved to the coordinator; network behavior is not exercised here
No App, browser, benchmark, workflow or heavy gate run
Exact changed-file count mismatch fails conservatively rather than attempting an unproven alternate file listing
